sampling: none (full local extract used; extract itself is already a minresp>=5 filtered subset of the raw .sav, per data/timss/_build_timss_gpcm.R)
design: single-session assessment (TIMSS 2019 G8 USA achievement booklet); each student answers one rotated booklet, one occasion. Item set here is the 31-item genuinely polytomous (0/1/2 partial-credit) constructed-response subset identified by _classify_items.R, not the full item pool (which also includes dichotomous MC/CR items).

domain_split_bonus.note: coarse M/S item-id prefix only, NOT a fine-grained KC crosswalk

c_d_growth_signal.reason: TIMSS is a single-occasion assessment: no repeated practice, no opportunity index, no learning-curve to compute. Not attempted.

e_f_g_decoupling_and_anchors.reason: No item-to-KC crosswalk is available locally for these items (only the coarse Math/Science domain prefix on the item id, reported above as a bonus, not a skill-level Q-matrix). KC-pair decoupling, pure-anchor coverage, and item-KC arity all require such a crosswalk and are not computed.

gpcm_bonus.note: classical GPCM (mirt, MML) already fit by data/timss/_build_timss_gpcm.R; reported as-is, not refit here.
